news.body:
## Today
- The 1,530 euros for Business Foundations is due today.
INSEAD wants the transfer with them and the payment proof emailed back to Celine Chin. If the money has gone and the proof has not, the proof is the half still outstanding.

## The visa clock is yours now
- Campus France finished the transfer yesterday and Delhi can see your file.
Nobody else is holding it. INSEAD's immigration officer puts the long-stay visa at seven to eight weeks, and you cannot file until you are in India: filed in your first week there it lands around the end of December, filed a week later the top of that range runs past 3 January. - Book the VFS slot for the days right after you land.

## Before Monday
- Next week carries the flight on the 4th, the KITAS expiry on the 8th and three application deadlines on the 8th.
InCorp has had no answer from you on the cancellation quotation since the 12th and the renewal window has already closed, so the permit lapses by itself unless you tell Chitra otherwise. - One line to her today is the cheapest thing on this list.
